question: The force of attraction between two bodies which is directly proportional to the product of masses of the bodies and inversely proportional to the square of the distance of separation is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**gravitational force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gravitational force is the force of attraction between two bodies due to their masses.
 
• It is directly proportional to the product of the masses of the two bodies.
 
• The force is inversely proportional to the square of the distance between the centers of the two bodies.
 
• This relationship is described by Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation.
 
• Gravitational force acts over large distances and is one of the four fundamental forces of nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electromagnetic Force**

 
 
• This is the force between charged particles.
 
• It includes both electric forces (between static charges) and magnetic forces (between moving charges).
 
 
 
• **Electrostatic Force**
 
 
• This is the force between stationary charged particles.
 
• It follows Coulomb's law, which states that the force is directly proportional to the product of the charges and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them.
 
 
 
• **Electromotive Force (EMF)**
 
 
• This is not an actual force but a potential difference that drives current in a circuit.
 
• It is measured in volts and is generated by sources like batteries and generators.
